name: Cyberpunk
basis: science-fiction genre look: neon split-tone, glowing edges, rain, scanlines, sign (how)

lumenary.blurb: Neon-lit night: split-toned colour, glowing outlines, rain and a flickering sign.

facts.bestOn: Night scenes, street photography and portraits

why: Cyberpunk pairs advanced technology with worn-out streets, and its look is neon on wet darkness. The colours here are split: shadows lean towards one neon and highlights towards another, with a hot white at the very top. Edges glow with a slight colour fringe, and rain, scanlines and a flickering sign supply the mood.
how: Map brightness through a five stop ramp: black, the first neon, the second neon, a hot highlight.
Draw two edge maps as glowing lines, a fine one and a wide one, offset by a fraction of a pixel so they fringe.
Scatter a few hundred short slanted strokes as rain.
Shift some thin horizontal bands sideways for the glitch, and darken every third row for scanlines.
Draw the sign text three times: a wide blur, a narrow blur, then sharp white.
history: The word came from Bruce Bethke’s 1983 short story “Cyberpunk”. William Gibson’s novel Neuromancer followed in 1984, and the film Blade Runner (1982) had already given the genre its rain-soaked neon skyline. Games and anime later turned the look into a whole visual language.
terms: Giving shadows one colour and highlights another.
Light that appears to spread past the edge of a bright shape.
A coloured edge caused by layers of different colours sitting a hair apart.
paragraphs: The base is a duotone-plus: a five-stop ramp from black through the first neon, the second neon and a hot highlight. Two edge maps are then drawn as glowing lines, a fine one in the second neon and a wider one in the first, offset by a fraction of a pixel so they never quite overlap, which gives the lines a coloured fringe.

Rain is a few hundred short slanted strokes of random length and transparency. The glitch shifts some thin horizontal bands sideways by copying their pixels. Scanlines darken every third row. The neon sign is the same text drawn three times, with a wide blur, a narrow blur and finally sharp white, and it sometimes flickers.

presets.text: Acid colours with extra glow look like a club at 3 a.m.
Maximum rain with no glitch keeps the picture clean and wet.
Change the sign to your own shop name.
